Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Matt wrote:
> 1. Does Dawn Op. make drawing out the beast damage agg? Even if I play
> combat ends as a strike?

Yes.

> 2. Can a tapped vamp play Cloak for someone else?

Superior, yes, if the someone else is controlled by the same player.

> 3. Can someone play fast reaction after I've played Form of Mist to
> continue at +1 stealth? Does my action continue after the Fast Reaction
> combat? What if that combat leaves me in torpor?

Form of Mist - Combat (pro)
* Any effect that starts a new combat after the combat that was ended by
superior Form of Mist will nullify the "continue action" effect. This
includes Psyche (superior), Fast Reaction, and Hidden Lurker.
[LSJ 09-JAN-1998]

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <8l1mpf$m2e$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, hamd...@my-deja.com writes

>> 2. Can a tapped vamp play Cloak for someone else?
>

>No. Vamp must be untapped to use Cloak at Sup.

Since card text does not require this, the Cloak takes all the normal
properties of an action modifier.

In a normal action, starting an action taps a vampire, so all other
action modifiers are played when that vampire is tapped. (The vampire
does not tap when the action is block or successful, they already are,
when they announce the action.) Hence, playing action modifiers when
tapped is not only possible, but generally the norm. So a Cloak, at
superior, can be played when a vampire is tapped.

--

James Coupe
